pr_metadata.title: docs(epic): Native HA / CRR metric contract + golden sample
pr_metadata.summary: Add the Wave 2 nha-crr-metric-contract.md for epic #169: the cluster_nha_* custom collector's exact metric names, labels, source CLI (dspmq -o nativeha -x/-g), parsing rules and emission logic (verbatim from nativehastate.py), the CRR link/lag/role + quorum/in-sync output mapping, a live-captured golden /metrics block, and the naming-reconciliation section.
pr_metadata.notes: Golden block captured live 2026-09-16 from node nha-rhel-crr-a1 against the running NHARCAPP QM (MQ 10.0, quorum 3/3, Recovery CRR group linked with a real 46-message backlog / INSYNC no). Metric names/labels/emission are copied verbatim from mq-resiliency-lab-for-linux src/mqlab/nativehastate.py @ develop b37e1d8; downstream clusterboard.py already binds these exact names, so nothing is invented. Two commits (doc + a markdownlint MD032 blank-line fix); vrg-validate green. Separate finding to flag (not part of this doc): the deployed collector timer is currently not emitting because nativehastate.py line 194 uses Python-2 except syntax and fails to compile on Py3 — the golden capture was produced by running the collector against live dspmq with that one line patched; recommend a lab-repo issue to fix it. The v6.0.0 mq-metric-samples obs-exporter refresh was intentionally NOT performed (large/destructive, unrelated to this node-exporter textfile collector) — see the session report.
